name: MIG/MMA-400 MIG Welder 400A

specs.accessories: 4m 35mm² cable, dual-drive wire feeder, 1.5m 35mm² negative cable, 500A ground clamp, 3m 24KD torch, 220V CO2 heated flowmeter regulator

summary: 400A MIG/MMA workhorse — our most balanced production welding machine.
description: The MIG/MMA-400 is the volume model of the MIG line: 400A at 80% duty, 2×G75N120 stage and the dual-drive feeder with 35mm² cables. One machine covers gas-shielded production welding and stick work, which is why it anchors so many distributor catalogs.
